tasks.title: Hello World
tasks.prompt: Create main.bmec with an app named HelloWorld and a typed greeting() function that returns exactly Hello, world!. Compile it and invoke it through the BMEC CLI.

tasks.title: A small CLI project
tasks.prompt: Use the public getting-started guide to create a project named greeting-cli. Add a typed greet(name text) function that returns Hello, <name>!, then check, test, build, and execute the function through the BMEC CLI.

tasks.title: Todo data app
tasks.prompt: In main.bmec, define a persistent Task model with required text title and boolean done defaulting to false. Add a Home page that uses CRUD for Task and its generated /tasks API. Compile and inspect the project facts.

tasks.title: A typed API
tasks.prompt: Extend main.bmec with a Note model containing required text title and optional text body. Expose the model at /notes and add a Home page with CRUD for Note. Compile the program and inspect its API and model facts.

tasks.title: Support dashboard
tasks.prompt: Build a small full-stack support dashboard. It needs Task and User models, a Dashboard page, TaskRow and TaskForm components, a responsive DashboardStyle, and database-backed list and create functions exposed at /tasks. Use the public docs, examples, and BMEC introspection to discover valid syntax; compile and inspect the project.

tasks.title: Booking business app
tasks.prompt: Build a small booking operations app in main.bmec. Define Customer and Appointment models with a typed Customer relationship; expose Appointment at /appointments; create an AppointmentForm with required-field validation; add a Dashboard CRUD page, responsive ScheduleStyle, and a passing BMEC test. Compile, run the test, and inspect the model, API, page, component, and style facts.
